headline: Approved prior meeting minutes; discussed Veterans Memorial Park sculpture installation and Green Community Festival plans.
summary: The group approved minutes from July 21 and August 18 unanimously. It discussed a sculpture installation at Veterans Memorial Park, expected within six weeks. It also reviewed plans for a gallery opening on September 24 and materials for the Green Community Festival.
decisions: Approved the minutes from July 21 and August 18 unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Minutes from July 21 and August 18 were reviewed and approved unanimously.

plain_text:
PAGE 1 
 
 
 
 
 
SOUTH BURLINGTON  
PUBLIC ART COMMITTEE MEETING 
Thursday, September 15, 2026 
 
The South Burlington PUBLIC ART COMMITTEE held a special meeting on Tuesday, 
September 115, 2026, at 5:30PM at 180 Market Street in Room 301, and by remote participation.  
Members Present: Sebastian Ryder (Chair), Amanda Holland, Sophia Babbitt, Isaac Cates, 
Karen Liamos, Thomas Lindley, Penne Tompkins, Mark Behr,  Bryce Myers, Ilona Blanchard 
(Staff Liaison, non-voting), Tim Barritt (City Council Liaison, non-voting)   
Members Not Present: Michele Bailey (Vermont Art Council, non-voting) 
 
Also in Attendance: Maedeh Asgharpur (Gallery Curator) 
 
1. The meeting was convened at 5:35 PM by Sebastian. 
a. All attendees were in-person except Sophia. 
b. Sophia was identified as the minute taker for the meeting. 
 
2. Minutes from July 21 and August 18 were reviewed and approved unanimously. 
 
3. Opportunity for Public comment on items not on other agenda - no public were present. 
4. Public Art and Sculpture Installation 
a. The sculpture at Veterans Memorial Park will face the Vermont National Country 
Club and be visible from the south and the recreation path. 
b. Signage will be simple and consistent with the park's signage system. 
c. Installation is expected within six weeks. 
d. A dedication event is tentatively planned for late October (10/15 or 11/5), with 
efforts to find a date when most members can attend. 
 
5. South Burlington Public Art Gallery  
a. Opening: 
i. The opening is scheduled for September 24, with setup starting at 4:30 
PM and the event running from 5:00 to 6:30 PM. 
ii. Volunteers are needed for setup and cleanup; one or two people at the start 
and end of the event are sufficient. 
iii. Posters and postcards for the event have been distributed and will be 
shared on social media and local bulletin boards.
Public Art Committee Meeting | Page 2 
b. Event Publicity and Social Media 
i. A Facebook event has been created; Instagram promotion is planned but 
requires coordination with communications staff. 
ii. Twitter presence is not yet established but may be developed with new 
marketing interns. 
6. Green Community Festival 
a. Materials and Crafting for Events 
i. Discussion on using recycled plastic bottles for art projects, including 
preparation methods like drilling holes and painting. 
ii. Safety concerns were raised about using glue guns and cutting bottles, 
with suggestions for supervision and proper tools. 
iii. Supplies such as glue guns, sticks, pipe cleaners, and scissors are being 
gathered and coordinated. 
iv. Bottles should be soft plastic, like seltzer bottles, preferably with caps to 
aid in crafting. 
b. Committee and Volunteer Coordination 
i. Volunteer sign-up forms have been sent out; members are encouraged to 
commit to shifts for setup and cleanup. 
ii. Coordination for bottle collection and drop-off is organized through 
personal networks and a central drop-off at a member's house. 
iii. The group plans to finalize volunteer schedules and logistics before the 
event. 
 
7. Annual Report FY 2026 
a. The annual report for fiscal year 2026 was reviewed with some comments; an 
amended version will be prepared for voting in October. 
b. The committee discussed the wording for the acceptance of the sculpture 
donation, emphasizing clarity and proper attribution to the donor. 
8. Other Business 
a. Brief mention of civil ordinances related to public behavior and safety. 
9. The meeting was adjourned at 7:00pm.  The next meeting will be at 5:30 PM Tuesday 
October 20, 2026 
 
Respectfully Submitted, 
 
Sophia Babbitt
